main_text.head: CAP. III.
De obedientia Christianorum, in Traianum sub persecutione tertia.
main_text.p: PRobitatis Traiani tanta apud suos opinio fuit, ut usque ad Eutropij aetatem (ipso in sua historia referente) non aliud Principibus a Senatu acclamaretur, nisi felicior Augusto, melior Traiano. Sub huius tamen imperio, ipso vel mandante, vel saltem conniuente, Consules & Prouinciarum Praefecti, acerbissimam in Christianos carnificinam exercuerunt, quorum multitudinem pariter & innocentiam, Plinius secundus Bythiniae Proconsul, ita in {m}Epi-stola ad Traianum palam indicat, dum fatetur se nihil aliud de eis comperisse, Epist. 101. lib. 10.“[Nisi quod soliti essent stato die ante “matutinam lucem convenire, carmenque Christo, quasi Deo dicere, seque “sacramento, non in scelus aliquod obstringere; sed ne furta, ne latrocinia, “ne adulteria committerent, ne fi-“dem fallerent, nè depositum appellati abne-

page.notes: Drop cap "P" at the start of the paragraph, read as P plus R. Printed "ftato" read as "stato" (long s). Italic "Augusto" uses a swash A. The reference mark "m" is in the text and repeated in the right margin note "Epist. 101. lib. 10.". The paragraph ends mid-word at "abne-" and continues on the next page. Opening quotation marks are printed at the start of each line of the quotation.
